name: FAQ · gym bold
description: High-contrast black and lime style with uppercase questions.

items.question: Is there a joining fee?
items.answer: No joining fee this month. Just pick a plan and start training the same day.

items.question: Can I freeze my membership?
items.answer: Yes, for up to three months per year if you are travelling, injured or on leave.

items.question: Are classes included?
items.answer: All group classes, from spin to HIIT to yoga, are included in every membership.

items.question: What are your opening hours?
items.answer: We are open 5am to midnight, every day of the year including holidays.
